findings.explanation: INV-1003-A and INV-1003-B are identical in vendor, amount (INR 70,800), tax (10,800), date (2026-07-16), and supplier invoice reference SSS/2026/188, indicating a duplicate submission of the same underlying invoice with no credit note or cancellation resolving it, though the single bank debit (BNK-1003) and single ledger entry (LED-1003) suggest only one payment was actually made.
